title: Chapter 1: Sounding Natural
sub: Common words that smooth out everyday talk.

examples: I reckon it'll rain later, so bring an umbrella.
I reckon we'll finish the report by Friday.
Do you reckon the shop is still open?
She reckons the new manager will be stricter.

cards.def: Causing difficulty or embarrassment; not smooth.
examples: There was an awkward silence after the joke fell flat.
It was awkward when I forgot my colleague's name.
The meeting room has an awkward shape for presentations.
He felt awkward at the party because he knew nobody.
I'm genuinely impressed by how far you've come.
She was genuinely happy for her friend's success.
I genuinely forgot about the meeting; I'm sorry.
The manager genuinely listens to our ideas.
